annotations.title: Close a fiscal year for good

description: The final close: a year already closed is frozen, and from then on nobody can reopen it or change it — not the owner, not an accountant, not the operator. Refused on an open year (fiscal_year_not_closed) and while a closed year before it is not finally closed. Whether the country requires it, and by when, is final_close in the answer of close_fiscal_year. Irreversible: call it only when the user has asked for this specific year to be closed for good.

fiscal_year_id.description: The closed year to close for good. Every closed year before it must already be finally closed.
